question: Is PrashnaHub really free?
answer: Yes. Core resources — notes, question banks, past papers and community Q&A — are 100% free for all Nepali students. A small set of premium features (advanced mock tests, AI assistant, downloadable e-books) supports the platform and keeps everything else free.

question: Which classes and boards do you cover?
answer: We cover NEB Class 12, CTEVT diploma programs, and Bachelor & Master degrees under TU, KU, PU, Purbanchal, Gandaki and other Nepali universities.

question: Are the notes and question banks updated to the new CDC curriculum?
answer: Yes. We continuously update resources to match the latest CDC and NEB curriculum. New-curriculum materials are tagged so you always know which syllabus a resource follows.

question: How do the mock tests work?
answer: Mock tests are timed and scored instantly. After each attempt you get a detailed breakdown by unit, a projected GPA, and step-by-step solutions so you can learn from every mistake.

question: Can I contribute my own notes?
answer: Absolutely! We welcome notes, question banks and study tips from toppers and teachers. Upload through your dashboard — verified contributions are rewarded with points, streaks and badges.

question: Do you offer resources for entrance exams?
answer: Yes. We provide past papers and mock tests for major entrance exams including TU CSIT, engineering (IOE), medical (IOM), agriculture, CTEVT and MBA admissions.

question: Is there a mobile app?
answer: PrashnaHub is a fully responsive web app that works great on phones, tablets and desktops. A native app is on our roadmap.

question: How can I track my progress?
answer: Your dashboard shows your study streak, minutes focused, tests attempted, leaderboard rank and subject-wise progress. Sync happens automatically when you're signed in.
